decisions.decision: AI route planning is available to all authenticated users during beta.
All users receive 5 successful route generations per UTC day.
All users receive 30 assistant replies per UTC day across sessions.
Keep existing subscriptions unchanged; preserve admin grants.
Keep Travel+ as a Soon preview and show a beta-unavailable notice instead of activating.
Restore tiered AI limits and real verified billing before commercial launch.

findings: Direct API activation bypasses a mobile-only purchase lock.
APP_ENV is not a reliable security boundary for mock checkout.
Per-session chat limits can be bypassed by opening another session.

verification.backend: 808 passed, 138 skipped; Ruff, formatting, MyPy and audit passed. Local coverage was 71.33% because service-backed integration suites were skipped.
verification.mobile: Flutter analyze and all 540 tests passed; Travel+ goldens updated and visually inspected.
verification.android: Release APK built successfully with the CI-safe Gradle profile.
